description: This file defines and implements various type classes related to union and optional types within the ATen core library of PyTorch, including methods for creating, comparing, and manipulating these types.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: Represents an optional type, possibly holding a specific contained type or None.

classes.name: UnionType
classes.description: Represents a union of multiple types, allowing for type flexibility.

methods.name: OptionalType::create
methods.description: Creates a new OptionalType with the specified contained type.

methods.name: OptionalType::ofTensor
methods.description: Returns an OptionalType that contains a TensorType.

methods.name: UnionType::create
methods.description: Creates a new UnionType from a vector of types, with special logic for optional types.

methods.name: UnionType::subtractTypeSet
methods.description: Subtracts a set of types from the union, returning the resulting type.

methods.name: UnionType::toOptional
methods.description: Converts the union to an optional type if possible.

methods.name: UnionType::equals
methods.description: Checks if this union type is equal to another type.

methods.name: UnionType::isSubtypeOfExt
methods.description: Checks if this union type is a subtype of another type, with detailed reasoning.

methods.name: OptionalType::equals
methods.description: Checks if this optional type is equal to another type.

methods.name: OptionalType::isSubtypeOfExt
methods.description: Checks if this optional type is a subtype of another type, with detailed reasoning.
